stemMd: Which objects can be selected while satisfying their lenders and the curator?
explanationMd: Copper can use the three days with two guards. Textile may use any three or four of days1–4. Crystal’s condition covers every exhibition day, not merely days displayed, so storing it on the final days does not cure the missing logger.

distractorRationale.a: Textile has four permitted days, enough for the three-day minimum.
distractorRationale.b: Crystal requires a logger throughout all six exhibition days, but it is unavailable on days5–6.
distractorRationale.d: Crystal fails the full-exhibition logger condition; Textile can be displayed on at least three of days1–4.
distractorRationale.e: Copper can be displayed on days2,3,5 with two guards.
